records.name: Salis - Transport Request Routing
records.description: Auto-assign new transport requests to the responsible Movement coordinator (round robin). DISABLED by default: replace the placeholder user with your real transport coordinators (Site Transport / Inter-City Relocation / Administrative Trip), then enable.

records.name: Salis - Support Ticket Routing
records.description: Auto-assign new support tickets across the division support team (load balancing). DISABLED by default: replace the placeholder user with your real support team, then enable.
